parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue with PositionField but may introduce regressions or functional incompleteness.

issues.description: The patch removes the check for hasattr(obj.model, item), which may break existing behavior for other valid use cases.
The patch does not fully resolve the issue for all edge cases, as it does not handle the case where hasattr(obj.model, item) is true but the field is None.
